name: Just-A-Crush
source:
Ryan invites his best friend Elijah over to hang out. He has something important he wants to tell him. Will he have the courage to do so?

[From [url=https://foxpancakes.itch.io/just-a-crush]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
瑞安邀请最好的朋友以利亚，来家里玩。他有件重要的事，想告诉对方。可他，能否鼓起勇气？

[摘自[url=https://foxpancakes.itch.io/just-a-crush]itch.io[/url]]
